message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes. Facts: Defendant illegally possessed (private storage) of various narcotics: heroin, MDMA, ketamine, methamphetamine, etc. Quantity: total >50g for heroin and meth? The prosecution says illegal possession of heroin, meth >50g. Under Chinese Criminal Law, illegal possession of narcotics over certain amounts is crime of "非法持有毒品罪" (illegal possession of narcotics). The statutory name: "非法持有毒品罪". According to correction rule: when listing crime name(s) between [罪名] and <eoa>, output only the statutory offense name without appending the character “罪”. So we should output "非法持有毒品". Also maybe multiple offenses if multiple distinct categories? But all are illegal possession of narcotics, same offense. So single crime.

Thus final answer: [罪名]非法持有毒品<eoa>
